text:
maya: Heads up — canary p99 jumped from 120ms -> 280ms after last merge (release/2026-03-16). Repro on canary for small batch sizes.

arjun: ugh. Which merge? commit hash?

maya: Merge is 4f3a9b2 (runtime: heuristics refactor). Canary metric: /models/llama2-7b serving route. Baseline before merge:
```
p99 120ms
mean 35ms
cpu 55%
```
After:
```
p99 280ms
mean 70ms
cpu 62%
```

henry: I reproduced locally with a load generator (single worker, batch_size=1, seq=512). I see a hotspot in kernel selector. Perf profile attached:
```
flame: pick_kernel() 48%
  choose_path() 22%
  calc_thresholds() 18%
```

lina: let's bisect. Suspect range: commit 3f1..4f3. I'll run git bisect on a perf-compatible branch. Any tips for a fast reproduce step in CI?

arjun: Use this script (fast, runs ~2 min):
```
# ./tests/perf/repro.sh --model llama2-7b --seq 512 --batch 1 --iters 100
# prints p99 in ms
```

maya: CI perf job also failed with same diff — CI-Perf flagged p99 regression (see job 5621). @ci-bot can you paste the log?

ci-bot: CI Perf job 5621: regression detected on route /generate. Baseline p99=118ms, current=276ms, delta +158%.

henry: I'm going to run a local bisect script that automates the repro and profiles. ping me if you want to sync.

lina: I'll start git bisect now and post results. If we find commit, we should consider a hotpatch revert then proper fix.

arjun: FYI, previous heuristics refactor touched kv-cache boundary conditions — maybe fallback path changed. Search for 'kv_window' in the range.

maya: noted. Also adding canary tag so we don't roll more traffic. :warning:

henry: first bisect step shows good at 3f4d9 and bad at 4f3a9b. Narrowing...

lina: bisect found 4a7c2e as first bad. Commit message: 'kernel-selector: adjust dynamic thresholding for small batches'.

arjun: interesting. Can you run with gate disabled? e.g., env KERNEL_DYNAMIC_THRESH=0

henry: with KERNEL_DYNAMIC_THRESH=0 on 4a7c2e p99 -> 122ms (back to baseline). That pins it.

maya: nice find. Suggest revert patch to revert that small change and run canary rollback.

lina: created PR #4123 with revert. Also assigning to @arjun and @henry for follow-up investigation. Link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4123

arjun: I'll follow-up on failing corner cases. Probably threshold calc wasn't accounting for kv cache hits.

maya: thanks team. Putting rollout on hold until revert merges. :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: Revert PR created; canary rollback scheduled after merge.

henry: leaving notes in the bisect log: /tmp/bisect-1813456789.log

maya: closing loop — postmortem to follow once we ship the fix. Good catch everyone. :pray:
